description_en: We have a 2+1+2 apartment for sale at Palladium Residence. The residential complex is located in one of the most desirable areas of the capital, on the hill of "Dry Lake". Easily accessible from the new ring road of Tirana. Information about the apartment: • Gross area: 118.36 m2. • Net area: 102 m2 • Floor 3 Organization: • Living room and kitchen • 2 Bedrooms • 2 Toilets • Balcony Other settings: • The complex is in the process of construction • Unobstructed view of the lake • Hood system • Ventilated facade • The apartment is located in a preferential area for housing and investment • Shared and relaxing environments that offer opportunities for socializing during your daily life, such as a swimming pool, gyms, entertainment facilities for children, etc. • The reception at the entrance of the building will be available to residents for any information they may need. • Physical barrier for noise, anti-seismic structure and well-organized infrastructure.
